highlights.name: 祈使句写作规范（指令体非对话体）
highlights.trigger: 起草或打磨 SKILL.md 正文时；发现"你应该/如果你需要 X"式第二人称对话体
highlights.evidence: skill-creator SKILL.md Step 4: "Write the entire skill using imperative/infinitive form (verb-first instructions), not second person. Use objective, instructional language (e.g., 'To accomplish X, do Y' rather than 'You should do X')"
highlights.point: 全文用动宾开头指令体（"加载 X"/"先跑 Y"），禁对话体；中文本地化表述为「指令体而非对话体」。我们的 designer-guide 仅约定 description 用第三人称，正文写作体例是空白【降级注记 2026-09-02 用户拍板：本条属施工层 SKILL.md 行文规范，主责 skill-creator；skill-designer 仅在交接 brief 约定中留一句「正文用指令体」，不入 absorbed-library 正式条目，勿升格】

highlights.name: AI 受众视角（写给另一个 agent 实例）
highlights.trigger: 写 SKILL.md 犹豫"这条要不要写"时；内容在人类看来精彩但对 AI 执行无增益
highlights.evidence: skill-creator SKILL.md Step 4: "remember that the skill is being created for another instance of Claude to use. Focus on including information that would be beneficial and non-obvious to Claude."
highlights.point: 受众是另一个 AI 实例而非人类读者——只收"对 AI 有益且非显然"的程序性知识；本地化：'Claude'改平台中立表述，并与面向用户的话术层（白话注释/FAQ）分层不混写

highlights.name: 正文四结构模式（与目录架构正交分层）
highlights.trigger: B07 画目录时用户追问"SKILL.md 正文章节怎么组织"
highlights.evidence: skill-creator scripts/init_skill.py SKILL_TEMPLATE L31-53: 四种 body 结构模式 Workflow-Based(顺序流程)/Task-Based(工具集合)/Reference-Guidelines(标准规范)/Capabilities-Based(能力系统) + "Patterns can be mixed and matched"
highlights.point: 我们 7 套 archetype 管目录架构（文件怎么分），四模式管正文层级（章节怎么排）——两层正交互补，补齐「body 怎么组织」空白；建议混搭：task 为主干 + 复杂操作嵌 workflow

highlights.name: 大文件 grep 检索模式内嵌
highlights.trigger: 某份 reference 文档超过约 1 万词、加载全文 token 代价过高时
highlights.evidence: skill-creator SKILL.md references 节: "If files are large (>10k words), include grep search patterns in SKILL.md"
highlights.point: 在 SKILL.md 对应条目旁内嵌 grep 检索模式串，agent 不加载全文也能精准命中段落；与既有「索引行/词数 diff」体检项互补——索引管发现，grep 模式管检索

highlights.name: 具体使用例反推资源清单
highlights.trigger: Phase 0/② 出稿前需求只有抽象描述、拿不出具体使用例
highlights.evidence: skill-creator SKILL.md Step 1-2: "analyze each example by: (1) Considering how to execute on the example from scratch (2) Identifying what scripts, references, and assets would be helpful when executing these workflows repeatedly"
highlights.point: 先逼出 2-3 个真实使用例（"用户会说什么来触发它"），逐例从零推演执行过程，把重复出现的动作沉淀为 scripts/references/assets 资源清单——补上「例→资源」的推导桥接，比抽象三问更落地

highlights.name: validate 门禁前置打包（fail-closed 发布）
highlights.trigger: 蓝图落地后要产出发布包或同步 dist 时
highlights.evidence: skill-creator scripts/package_skill.py L47-54: "Run validation before packaging... if not valid: print('Validation failed...') return None"——校验不过拒绝出 zip
highlights.point: 打包与校验合成一条命令、校验不过 fail-closed；反观我们 prepare_release 手工 cp 与 validate 分离，可加 sd_cli package 把 validate --self 设为打包硬门禁（防同步遗漏裸奔发布）
